title: Functional Capacity Evaluation Protocols by Work Status and Time Since Injury
content:
# Functional Capacity Evaluation protocols

A Functional Capacity Evaluation under a Workers' Compensation Referral is run on one of three protocols. The protocol is chosen from the worker's work status on file and the calendar days since the date of injury, and it fixes the protocol hours of the evaluation.

**Protocol rule.** The protocol hours are the program's maximum daily billable hours plus half of them, rounded down (a two-day protocol), where the worker's work status on file is off work and more than one hundred twenty (120) calendar days have passed since the date of injury; the program's maximum daily billable hours less one (a job-matched protocol) where the work status on file is modified duty and more than one hundred twenty calendar days have passed since the date of injury; and the program's maximum daily billable hours (a one-day protocol) otherwise.

The Functional Capacity Evaluation program's maximum daily billable hours are 4.

## Protocol matrix

| Work status on file | Days since the date of injury | Protocol | Protocol hours (maximum daily billable hours of 4) |
|---|---|---|---|
| off work | more than 120 | two-day protocol | 4 plus half of 4 (2), that is 6 |
| modified duty | more than 120 | job-matched protocol | 4 less 1, that is 3 |
| off work | 120 or fewer | one-day protocol | 4 |
| modified duty | 120 or fewer | one-day protocol | 4 |
| full duty | any | one-day protocol | 4 |

## Edges

- Off work, exactly 120 days since injury: one-day protocol. Off work, 121 days: two-day protocol.
- Modified duty, exactly 120 days: one-day protocol. Modified duty, 121 days: job-matched protocol.

The date of injury and the work status are those on the referral record.
